name: Sunadori Satori
source:
Satori is a roommate of [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] and a classmate and best friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c14897]Chimari[/url].

She is a true pervert. Imagining everything with anything.

She likes very much [url=https://vndb.org/c69174]Yukito[/url] calling him her "Prince", but we don't know if it's in a romantic way.

[spoiler]She is very imaginative and fantasizes tremendously about [url=https://vndb.org/g89]brother / sister incestuous relationships[/url].

Aside from her perversity, she is a sharp-witted girl who manages to reason well in the most stressful situations.[/spoiler]
